candidate_bathroom_river_containing_pak_.observation: Home bath scene loads without a crash and the water is clearly more transparent than baseline.

confirmed_semantics.description: Restores visibly greater water visibility/transparency in the home bathroom field.

water_shader_swater_original_code.observation: Crashes near the start of New Game loading when active alone.

height_fog_shader_original_code.observation: The first cutscene plays; the game crashes immediately after it when active alone.

event_group.observation: New Game, the first cutscene, the tested prologue path and the home bath scene run without a crash, but no profile-specific visual effect was confirmed. B+C looks the same as B-only in the tested bath scene.

shader_failure_investigation.hypothesis: The transplanted source DXBC executable code may assume source-side registers, constant buffers, resource bindings or signatures that do not match the Quartet target layout.
required_next_steps: Compare source and target per program: RDEF, ISGN, OSGN, shader model, constant buffers, variables, offsets, resources, bind points, program order and executable register usage.
Split swater into vertex-only and pixel-only variants.
Split modified heightfog programs into separately testable variants.
Prefer minimal patches to Quartet target bytecode over wholesale source executable-code transplantation.
Test every repaired variant through the Fast Test Lab.
Do not set runtime_validated=true before a real game test.
